gates.joint_quality: Room IoU, instance F1, and count MAE improve jointly on calibration and disjoint holdout.
gates.owner_geometry: At least one of Room IoU or instance F1 must improve on holdout without the other regressing.
gates.stability: The final three epochs must not reverse the selected calibration direction.
gates.safety: Validity, watertightness, outside-footprint, wall, opening, node, edge, and GED gates do not regress.

claim_boundary: The mask/owner residual and the dense owner-assignment follow-up both fail the joint-quality gate; neither is promoted.
